scripts.dev:setup: docker compose --env-file .env.development up -d --wait && pnpm install && set ENV=development&& pnpm --filter api exec prisma generate && set ENV=development&& pnpm --filter api run migrate && set ENV=development&& pnpm --filter api run seed:if-needed
